name: WaveNet denoiser, Model I (Wei & Huerta 2020)
source: Fig. 1 (block structure: input conv, ReLU, gated dilated layers with skip connections, summed skips, two 1x1 convolutions) and Sections 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 (dilations, repeats, channel counts)
unknowns: Kernel size, input and output channels of the first 'Conv' layer after the input are not stated
The gated activation (Tanh branch multiplied by a sigmoid branch) has no multiply glyph in the fixed symbol set; it is drawn as one dilated convolution with the gate named in the label and cells
Skip connections from every residual layer (110 of them) are drawn as a single loop from the block to the summing node
Padding is 'same' (zeros on both sides); stride is 1; no normalisation is mentioned
Model II differs: dilations 2^0 to 2^11 (12 layers) repeated six times (72 layers), 256 channels in the repeating blocks and 128 (not 64) in the penultimate layer; it is not drawn separately
Activation after the last 1x1 convolution is not stated; none is drawn
notes: Model I: 11 dilated layers (dilations 1, 2, 4 up to 1024) stacked as a block and repeated ten times (110 residual layers), 128 channels, non-causal (dilated convolutions with kernel 3 look at past and future). Input and output are 1 x 8192 tensors (1 s at 8192 Hz).
